correctness.rationale: The unique source/sink peeling proof handles singleton/transitive exceptions; the two-variable recursive source and sink formulas are correctly scoped and select the exact deletion ranks. Every core vertex has both in- and out-neighbors inside the core, guaranteeing a permanent two-pebble response. Distinguishing formulas prove the converse. For each size n all \(h+t\le n-3\) are realized, giving \(1+\binom{n-1}{2}\), and the minimal representative is forced to have a three-cycle core. Two independent standard-library verification programs reproduced 1,699 finite-model refinements and 157 independent complete finite two-pebble games; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification of a standard unrestricted infinite class of finite relational structures rather than a parameter slice. It reveals the sharp expressivity boundary: FO2 sees arbitrarily long initial/terminal universal-win/loss chains yet loses every internal distinction in any source-free/sink-free tournament. It yields a closed n-vertex logical-spectrum formula and unique minimum representatives, addressing exact natural finite-model-theoretic invariants rather than a routine table recomputation.
